meta.rounding: All dollar amounts rounded to the nearest $10 per project instruction.
meta.comparison_basis: All three strategies are notionally liquidated at the horizon and taxed, with cash flows received along the way added back. No scenario wins by deferring tax.
meta.disclaimer: Planning model, not tax or legal advice. Every statutory input carries a primary-source citation; every planning input is labelled as an assumption with a range.

prop19_comparison.note: Prop 19 applies only if Property A was the transferor's principal residence AND becomes the transferee's principal residence. It does not apply to a rental home, and it is lost once the heir stops occupying the property.

estate_headroom.note: The federal basic exclusion is $15,000,000 per decedent for 2026 (IRS) and is indexed for inflation from 2027 under the enacted legislation. Because the IRS has not published the forward indexed amounts, every year after 2026 shows the 2026 figure as a FLOOR — actual future exclusions will be higher, so the modelled tax is an upper bound.
